map.输入针织物线圈长度、纱线线密度、纵密与横密，计算其单位面积克重(g/m²)，用于: Enter knitted fabric loop length, yarn linear density, wale density and course density to compute areal weight (g/m²), for weight control and cost accounting in knitted fabric development and process sheets.
map.针织布按线圈长度、纱支与密度估算 GSM: Estimate GSM for knitted fabric from loop length, yarn count and density
map.调机时改密度/纱支预判克重变化: When changing machines, predict fabric weight change from density or yarn count
map.同组织不同规格快速估重: Quick weight estimation for different specifications of the same fabric
map.：横密 10 针/cm、纵密 14 针/cm → 单位面积针数 140/cm²；: : course density 10 stitches/cm, wale density 14 stitches/cm -> 140 stitches per cm²; loop length 4 mm, tex 18 -> single loop weight ≈ 4 × 18/1e6 = 7.2e-5 g; GSM ≈ 140 × 7.2e-5 × 10000 ≈ 100.8 g/m² (tissue coefficient included).
map.：纵密由 14 提到 16 针/cm → 针数 160/cm² → GSM 升至: : raising wale density from 14 to 16 stitches/cm -> 160 stitches/cm² -> GSM rises to about 115 g/m², a denser fabric.
map.为什么是估算不是精确值？: Why is it an estimate and not an exact value?
map.未计入组织系数与回潮，公式给近似值；精确 GSM 以称重为准。: Tissue coefficient and moisture regain are not included, so the formula gives an approximation; accurate GSM comes from weighing.
map.线圈越长用纱越多、布越稀软；越短越密实但可能发硬。: Longer loops use more yarn and give a looser, softer fabric; shorter loops are denser but can feel stiff.
